name: The Missing Diplomat
label: Quest
description: A tavern regular points you toward Commander Samaul in Theramore. He may help you locate Hendel, a Kul Tiras Marine.
intro: A tavern regular points you toward Commander Samaul in Theramore. He may help you locate Hendel, a Kul Tiras Marine.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A pleasure to meet you, friend. I am Commander Samaul. I'm in charge of Miss Proudmoore's forces here in Theramore.
Although I'm quite busy, if you have any questions, please feel free to speak up. I might have to keep it short, but there's no reason for me to be rude if you need my help.
If you plan on traveling out of the city, I'd suggest you be careful. Besides ogres, orcs and murlocs, the southern part of the swamp is filled with black dragons.
